title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Webtoon Returns as Anime Release Date Remains Uncertain
excerpt:
The Korean webtoon's second season is scheduled to begin on November 24, 2026.
Its anime adaptation remains in production without a confirmed premiere date.
body_md:
Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint, one of the most prominent Korean fantasy webtoons alongside Solo Leveling, is preparing to resume publication. REDICE Studio announced that the Korean edition's second season will begin on November 24, 2026, accompanied by a brief 30-second teaser.

The first season went on hiatus in May 2026 after chapter 311, stopping at a major turning point near the end of the Demon King Selection arc. The returning chapters are expected to pick up that storyline before moving into the next stage of the narrative. The webtoon has adapted almost half of the original web novel. Predictions that its second season could be the last remain speculation rather than a confirmed production plan.

English-language readers have also received an update. The official Webtoon release resumed on November 21 after a break that began following chapter 308 in June. The precise timetable for the English release of the new season has not been confirmed.

Meanwhile, an anime adaptation is in development. The project was announced at Crunchyroll's industry panel in July 2024, but no official premiere date has been established. A report associated with Com2uS mentioned 2028, although major distribution and production partners have not formally confirmed that schedule.

The international success of Solo Leveling has helped raise expectations for another high-profile Korean adaptation. For now, however, the concrete announcement concerns the Korean webtoon's return, not the anime's debut.
seo_title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Webtoon Season 2 Returns
seo_description: The Korean Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint webtoon returns November 24, 2026, while the anime's premiere date remains unconfirmed.
